headline: NFL Lab dress rehearsal is underway.
summary: Schedule, identity, usage, matchup, practice-report, weather, results, and private TD/receiving shadow contracts are wired. Recommendations remain gated until every player-data input passes.

currentPhase.label: Dress Rehearsal
currentPhase.objective: Run shadow projections, automated updates, result grading, and the final Week 1 integrity sweep.

phases.label: Training Camp Inputs
tasks: Keep unavailable snaps and routes explicitly gated

dataContracts.purpose: Canonical 2026 regular-season schedule with provider game/team IDs, kickoff, venue, and broadcast context.
Daily NFL slate shell with kickoff, teams, venue, weather, and game environment.
Canonical 32-team identity table used to join schedule, roster, usage, and market sources.
Eligible players by market with team, opponent, position, depth role, and availability.
Latest team-by-team QB/RB/WR/TE depth slots, ranks, starters, and canonical player-ID joins.
Roster-reported preseason injuries with explicit partial coverage until weekly practice reports begin.
Three-season targets, carries, passing, yardage, touchdown, and red-zone opportunity baselines for current players.
Availability-adjusted 2026 role certainty using current depth rank, historical opportunity, and team continuity.
Verified weekly player-to-game assignments plus historical team scoring, pace, and defense-versus-position touchdown context.
Private Anytime TD shadow rankings built from verified goal-line, red-zone, touchdown, role, and recent-opportunity inputs.
Official weekly availability and regular-season role gates that fail closed before reports begin.
Indoor verification and kickoff-hour forecasts with horizon and freshness rejection.
Private receiving-yards shadow signals; routes, confirmed roles, matchup, and weather remain required.
Pre-kickoff snapshot and postgame grading contract with anti-leakage rules.
Final identity, ownership, inactive-player, weather, role, and manual-navigation launch gate.
Source-by-source availability and gating status; projections remain disabled until required inputs pass validation.
Supported and deferred prop markets with required model inputs.
Future ranked recommendations once role, market, and line data are live.

integrityRules: No fake player projections before data sources exist.
Separate preseason usage signals from regular-season model confidence.
Mark missing depth-chart, injury, role, route, or weather inputs as pending instead of inventing values.
Every market must eventually connect to a result-tracking path.
nextBuildSteps: Activate official weekly practice reports when providers begin publishing Week 1 designations.
Require complete kickoff-hour weather coverage once every game enters the forecast horizon.
Keep routes optional for TD candidates and mandatory for receiving-yards recommendations.
Run TD and receiving-yards shadow boards through Week 1 and grade only pre-kickoff snapshots.
